topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: L-DACS integration impacts spectrum sharing by introducing interference, delay, and Doppler challenges. Adaptive techniques like dynamic frequency allocation, beamforming, MIMO, and channel estimation mitigate these issues, enhancing capacity and reducing interference. Precise beam steering and spatial multiplexing optimize link quality and spectrum efficiency.
reference_context: L-DACS1 and L-DACS2 technologies aim to mitigate saturation in aeronautical communication systems, providing secure data services with FDD and TDD techniques.
